# fastprogress

> A fast and simple progress bar for Jupyter Notebook and console, supporting nested (master/child) bars, real-time graph plotting, and both interactive and non-interactive environments.

fastprogress is a lightweight Python library by Sylvain Gugger (fast.ai) that provides `master_bar` and `progress_bar` iterators for tracking nested loops. It renders smoothly in Jupyter notebooks and terminals, supports inline loss-curve plotting via `update_graph`, and gracefully falls back to plain text output when stdout is redirected.
